name: mushi-mushi
description: Triage user-felt bugs, pull evidence (screenshots, console logs, network requests), check blast radius, and dispatch fix PRs — all from your AI coding agent. Mushi sees what users feel; Sentry sees what code throws.

MUSHI_API_KEY.title: Mushi API key
MUSHI_API_KEY.description: Only for the mushi-stdio fallback. A project key with the mcp:read scope (mcp:write to dispatch fixes), minted in the Mushi console under Settings → API Keys. The hosted mushi server signs in with OAuth and needs no key.

MUSHI_PROJECT_ID.title: Mushi project ID
MUSHI_PROJECT_ID.description: Only for the mushi-stdio fallback. The project UUID the key belongs to; optional for single-project keys.

MUSHI_API_ENDPOINT.title: Mushi API endpoint
MUSHI_API_ENDPOINT.description: Only for self-hosted deployments using the mushi-stdio fallback: your …/functions/v1/api URL. Leave empty for Mushi Cloud.
